# data/external/

Public data downloaded for use in the analysis that was provided by neither the Crick nor the collaborator, for example published datasets from GEO.

Published reference genomes and annotation (for example the Ensembl mm10 FASTA) are not kept here; they belong in `resources/references/`. A custom genome is data and belongs elsewhere in `data/`.

Record the source, accession and date of download for each dataset, or keep a download script alongside it.
